reuse.reason: Reuse immutable NativeArray/Order/NativeSet/Error and a single AppInfo definition. The nested main macros of old k0_actual_r2 cannot be safely renamed by another outer include, so its old entry/Read are neither included nor invoked. No source-string rewrite or retained-file edit.

reader_cli: --read k0|constant CPU|GPU DATA_DIR DT RUNTIME_XML NEW_REVIEW_DIR [--smoke]
entry: Set exactly PorosityObserver=PorosityFeedback=DynamicPorePressure=true then call actual JSphGpuSingle::Run. No pressure, position, clock, state, material, force or integration formula is assigned by the fixture. Public GPU master remains false; existing actual scope/time/domain guards remain active.
runtime_XML: Before any Run and every offline read, independently parse runtime XML. Require exact k literal0 or0.0001, CPU public master true versus GPU false/absent, conductivity model0/Ck0, g0, fixed elastic E/nu/cohesion and water/porosity/inertia constants, no SPR/HG/damping/DDT/shifting/load/drainage/Shepard, corrected stress/pair compression, fixed declared dt/end/cadence and original loss/passive-density limits. Parent-owned receipts must hash-bind this exact XML to the actual call; the reader does not reconstruct a run receipt from a file path.

models.k0: New complete-rate k0 bridge, not the old fused k0 implementation. Full native equality to old k0 is not presumed or required; keep original half/cross bounds and disclose bit differences.
models.constant: k is hydraulic conductivity in m/s, actual float-promoted1e-4=9.999999747378752e-5. No k(J), discontinuous-interface method or new public input.

windows.Debug_smoke: One fresh actual GPU exactly2 completed steps, coarse dt2^-24,end2^-23,cadence=dt,3native frames; selected explicitly by --smoke and reviewed before any full integration is admitted.
windows.full: Each explicitly owned coarse/half job uses dt2^-24/2^-25,end2^-15,cadence2^-23,257actual native frames;512/1024 completed steps. The same full shape is readable in Debug or Release but compilation is not run authorization.
windows.native: 512 soil IDs0..511,32x16,dp1/256,Lx1/8,Lz1/16,no actual wall particles,XZ periodic. Original retained initial BI4 remains byte exact; no GenCase or physical-state overwrite.
windows.initial: float vx=(1/512)sin(2pi*x/Lx),vy=vz=p=p0=sigma=theta=0,J1,n.25. Read initial native positions and fields exactly, rather than comparing nominal grid labels.

native_reader.retained_positive_CPU: Root identified controls periodic_constant_c/h from public CPU stage (raw outputs/upl_cpu_public_r1_periodic_constant_{c,h}/data). Re-read these original native files with their exact runtime XML. Their old owned CPU call used one OMP thread; do not claim a new CPU job/thread count/timing benchmark.
native_reader.typed_original_fields: Require all15 original arrays finite and ID-aligned, double Posd/stress state, actual float pressure/p0/excess/passive density, six stress rounding checks, plastic0,p0/load0,no exclusions and correct saved time/zero-based Step/typed signed dterror<=1e-14.
native_reader.porosity: J,n,theta are actual saved double arrays for both backends. n(J) and solid-volume ledger use original5e-13 bound; weak |J-1|<=1e-4 and full natural maxJ>1e-8. Smoke only predeclares nonempty maxJ>0, not a relaxed full gate.
native_reader.CPU: Actual double V,rho_t,k arrays and actual float PosDiv required, plus typed public model metadata true/schema1/model0/Ck0. Native k must equal the selected float-promoted declared constant in every row.
native_reader.GPU: V,rho_t,k and PosDiv/public model metadata must be absent. Common V and rho_t are explicitly derived from actual J and bound material; k is explicitly derived from the bound runtime XML/model, never called a native GPU observation.
native_reader.binary: physical.bin little-endian header[512,33,257] or smoke[512,33,3], then each frame actual binary64 time and512 ID-sorted rows of33 binary64 values. No PosDiv placeholder column.
native_reader.shear_order: Native SigmaState_ij=(xy,yz,xz) explicitly reordered to common(xy,xz,yz).
native_reader.last_poro: ID-sorted actual saved final J/n/theta may be byte-compared to the fresh actual GPU live_final.csv; this does not replace whole-field review.
